note: Deterministic workflows and read-only reports ONLY. No Cube-side LLM steps in the demo path — Ember is the only brain. Phase 3 read tools run through the Metatron MCP Bus (JSON-RPC tools/call); the formerly-broken list_connectors/get_asset wrappers are fixed bus-side (Nov 26, 2026). Since Nov 26, 2026 the live backend DISCOVERS its read tools from the bus (tools/list, eligibility-filtered) at startup and merges them over this catalog, which remains the fallback when the bus is unreachable and the source of the Ember-local gated tools. Every read is a pure data fetch — no model runs. Approval tokens are injected by the orchestrator's approval step and are never shown to Ember. EXCLUDED from the MCP bus on purpose: create_ticket (triggers Axion auto-triage), knowledge_search (embedding model), ask_cube (calls Axion). Phase 4 adds three gated write tools (create_agent_flow, file_intake, file_document_report): Ember proposes params/extractions only, a deterministic validator checks them, and execution needs the single-use approval token. Built agent flows contain no LLM steps and are created DISABLED; enable_agent_flow publishes+enables a registry-listed draft only after a second human approval. Image intake is read by Ember itself (multimodal) — no OCR/embedding/STT model runs in this path. File export (Nov 26, 2026): export_file generates CSV/XLSX/JSON/TXT/DOCX deterministically from filed data (intake extractions incl. audio/video transcripts, triage board, document reports, last run results) after human approval — no model runs in generation; downloads are Operator+-gated. Dashboard Builder (Nov 27, 2026): create_dashboard lets Ember author a dashboard spec against the live data profile; validation + rendering are deterministic (the Dashboard Generator's Axion design step is never used; Ember specs disable insight/chat so no Cube-side model runs). PLC Code Converter (Nov 27, 2026): convert_plc_code lets Ember convert PLC programs Allen-Bradley<->Siemens with the vendor instruction-reference manuals injected as long context by deterministic file reads (no KB search, no Cube-side model). A deterministic validator requires a complete per-instruction coverage report (unsupported instructions flagged, never silently replaced) and target-platform code before approval is offered. Converted code is DRAFT for qualified-engineer review and is never auto-deployed; change approval runs through a Metatron RPA flow (ITSM change record + approval waitpoint). Medical Manual Q&A (Nov 27, 2026): ask_medical_manual is an Ember-local read over The Merck Manual of Diagnosis & Therapy, 19th Ed. (4,114 pages, chunked by chapter/section with printed-page citations). Retrieval is deterministic keyword BM25 in-process — no embeddings, no KB search, no Cube-side model. Ember answers only from returned passages, citing chapter/section/pages; covered=false means say the manual does not cover it. Demo reference only, never medical advice; serve.py appends the disclaimer deterministically. Paralegal Assistant (Nov 27, 2026): ask_paralegal is an Ember-local read over US public-domain legal sources — United States Code (OLRC USLM XML, release point Public Law 119-142), Federal Rules of Civil/Criminal/Appellate/Bankruptcy Procedure and Evidence (uscourts.gov PDFs), US Constitution (archives.gov transcript), Code of Federal Regulations (govinfo bulk XML, 2025 annual edition). Retrieval is deterministic keyword BM25 (SQLite FTS5) in-process — no embeddings, no KB search, no Cube-side model. Ember answers only from returned passages, citing per section/rule (e.g. 28 U.S.C. § 1331, Fed. R. Civ. P. 26, U.S. Const. amend. XIV, 29 C.F.R. § 1910.95); covered=false means say the sources do not cover it. Legal information only, never legal advice for a specific case; serve.py appends the disclaimer deterministically.

tools.description: Build a deterministic RPA workflow (fetch -> condition -> actions). DISABLED draft.
tools.name: create_agent_flow

actions.description: One or both actions, run in order after the fetch (and condition gate, if set): whatsapp = notify via the proven Watcher WhatsApp flow; board = file the composed report to the orchestrator board.

autonomy.description: Trust level: propose-only (default), auto-report, auto-silent. Still DISABLED.

condition.description: Optional numeric gate: the action(s) run only when the fetched data satisfies field <op> value. Fields are per-source (see system prompt). Omit for an unconditional process.

source.description: Allowlisted Cube read endpoint the agent fetches.

tools.returns: Flow id, name, DISABLED status, trigger/source/actions/condition/chain/autonomy, process step summary.

tools.description: File Ember-extracted fields from an attached file. Needs approval.
tools.name: file_intake

fields.description: Extracted fields, e.g. vendor, invoice_number, date, line_items, subtotal, total_due. Only fields actually shown; omit blank/absent ones.

notes.description: Factual observations only (e.g. illegible text). No arithmetic verdicts - totals are verified by the tool.

tools.returns: Filed count, intake board total, kind, stored fields, deterministic totals_check verdict (invoices).

tools.description: File an Ember document-analysis report (findings with line refs). Needs approval token.
tools.name: file_document_report

line.description: Line number as numbered in the document text.

tools.returns: Filed count, reports total, title, findings count.

tools.description: Enable a DISABLED Agent Builder draft. Registry-scoped. Needs approval.
tools.name: enable_agent_flow
tools.returns: Flow id, name, ENABLED status, trigger/cron.

tools.description: Export filed data to a file (CSV/Excel/JSON/TXT/Word). Needs approval token.
tools.name: export_file

source.description: intake (latest extraction), board (triage tickets), document (latest report), last_run (previous run results), plc (latest PLC conversion), medical (latest medical-manual answer with cited passages), legal (latest paralegal answer with cited passages).

tools.returns: Export id, filename, format, source, size, and the download path — or an honest no-data message when the source is empty.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Build a live dashboard from Cube data (Ember designs, Metatron renders).

endpoints.description: 1-3 Cube data sources. The data profile for the chosen sources is provided with the request — reference ONLY its fact, list, and column names. With 2+ sources every name is prefixed with its source (e.g. capacity_host_disk_pct).

field.description: A fact name from the profile.

from.description: A list name from the profile.

thresholds.description: Optional alert thresholds evaluated at refresh (max 8).

refresh_frequency.description: Optional: also create a DISABLED RPA refresh flow on this schedule. Omit for manual refresh.

tools.returns: Dashboard slug, title, live URL, source labels, KPI/chart counts, refresh mode — or a validation error naming the fix.

tools.name: convert_plc_code
tools.description: Convert PLC code Allen-Bradley<->Siemens using vendor manuals. DRAFT; needs approval.

source_code.description: The full source program text (Studio 5000 ST/ladder-text or Siemens SCL).

converted_code.description: The full converted program in the target platform's language, written by Ember using the vendor manuals provided as context.

coverage.description: Per-instruction coverage report accounting for EVERY instruction in the source: mapped with its target equivalent, or unsupported (flagged, never silently replaced).

note.description: Mapping note, or why unsupported and what redesign is needed.

notes.description: Conversion notes: assumptions, tag/type mapping, anything an engineer must check.

tools.returns: Conversion id, direction, program name, coverage stats (mapped/unsupported counts + flagged list), converted code, DRAFT status — or a validation error naming the fix. Never deploys anything.

tools.name: ask_medical_manual
tools.description: Answer a medical question from the Merck Manual, cited. Read-only.
tools.returns: Retrieved passages from The Merck Manual of Diagnosis & Therapy (19th Ed.) with chapter/section/page citations and a covered flag (false = the manual does not cover the question; say so, never answer from general knowledge). Demo reference only — not medical advice, no personalized diagnosis/treatment.

tools.name: ask_paralegal
tools.description: Answer a legal question from US public-domain sources, cited. Read-only.
tools.returns: Retrieved passages from the U.S. Code, Federal Rules, US Constitution, and CFR with per-section/rule citations (e.g. 28 U.S.C. § 1331, Fed. R. Civ. P. 26, U.S. Const. amend. XIV, 29 C.F.R. § 1910.95) and a covered flag (false = the sources do not cover the question; say so, never answer from general knowledge). Legal information only — not legal advice for a specific case.
